_comment: Phase-2 triage (docs/TOOL_TRIAGE_DRAFT.md §3a): 13 raw FastLink tools + ask_caller/report_done = 15. fast_click_xy stays until the fast_click{x,y} fold lands in tools.js. Select with --toolset phase2. Descriptions keyed by REAL tool name.

describe.fast_snapshot: Read the current page: interactive elements (text, label, live value, coords) plus readable content blocks. Pass overlay:true when an open menu's options are missing, full:true to lift the ~70-item cap, screenshot:true only to visually confirm.
describe.fast_text: Return the page's innerText (or one element's via selector; html:true for outerHTML). Use for data extraction such as tables and lists; maxLen caps the size.
describe.fast_click: Click the element whose text/label/placeholder matches `text` (narrow with role, tag, index). Returns a fresh snapshot, so do not call fast_snapshot right after.
describe.fast_click_xy: Trusted click at viewport CSS coordinates x,y; returns no snapshot. Only when fast_click cannot match the element (canvas, cross-origin iframe).
describe.fast_fill: Set one field by label/placeholder/name (`match`, `value`; disambiguate with index or section). Replaces the existing value and returns a fresh snapshot.
describe.fast_select_option: Choose `option` in the dropdown labelled `field` (native, react-select, Angular, ARIA). Use selections:{field:option} to set several in one call.
describe.fast_key_press: Press `key` (Enter, Escape, Tab, ArrowDown...) on the focused element.
describe.fast_scroll: Scroll the page or the nearest scroll container: to:"top"|"bottom"|"50%" or pixels (negative = up). Returns a fresh snapshot.
describe.fast_wait: Wait until `text` appears (default 5s) or, with networkIdle:true, until requests settle. Use only after an action that triggers async loading; returns the matched element and a snapshot.
describe.fast_tab: Open `url` in a new tab and focus it.
describe.fast_nav: Go to `url` in the current tab and wait for the load (waitMs, default 10s).
describe.fast_batch: Run several tool calls in order in one round-trip (actions:[{name,args}]); stops at the first failure unless continueOnError. Use when the next steps are already certain.
describe.fast_evaluate: Run a JS function (`fn`, optional `args`) in the page and return its JSON result. May be disabled for this browser; if so use fast_text or fast_snapshot instead.
describe.report_done: Finish the task: result = the outcome in at most 3 short sentences (only what the task asked for), evidence = ONE short quote read back from the page plus its URL. Keep both terse; every output token costs latency.
